intro: Technology and government sectors bore the brunt of a wave of remote code execution attacks between April 12 and May 21, 2026. ZCyberNews tracked 33 articles, with 21 rated critical and 11 high. The threat actor PhantomCore was observed exploiting critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-20223 (CVSS 10), CVE-2025-54987, CVE-2026-22679, CVE-2026-31251, and CVE-2026-45033. Affected regions spanned Asia, China, Global, and Russia, with impacts also recorded in manufacturing, research, and software development sectors.
